title: Optimal convergence of local discontinuous Galerkin methods for convection-diffusion equations
summary: The $hp$ local discontinuous Galerkin (LDG) method proposed by Castillo et al. [Math. Comp.,~71 (238): 455-478, 2002] has been shown to be an efficient approach for solving convection-diffusion equations. However, theoretical analysis indicates that, for solutions with limited spatial regularity, the method exhibits suboptimal convergence in $p$, suffering a loss of one order, comparing to numerical experiments.
